matchReport.title: Inglis defiant but Aussies fall to heavy defeat in Lahore
matchReport.standFirst: Stand-in captain Josh Inglis hit 65 but his lone hand with the bat was not enough as Pakistan claimed the ODI series despite an Aussie fightback with the ball
